get.summary: Lists tags in a scope, optionally filtered by a name prefix.
get.description: Returns the tenant-scoped tags registered under the given scope, ordered by name. The scope query parameter is mandatory; cross-scope search is exposed by the dedicated /api/v1/taxonomy/search endpoint introduced in story T3.1. The optional q parameter applies a case-insensitive name prefix filter for autocomplete-style lookups.

post.summary: Creates a new tag in the current tenant.
post.description: Creates a new tag in the supplied scope. Returns 201 with the persisted tag. Returns 422 when a tag with the same (TenantId, Scope, Name) already exists.

get.description: Returns the tag identified by the route id. Returns 404 when the tag is missing or excluded by the tenant filter.

patch.summary: Partially updates a tag (name / colour / hide-on-entity-card).
patch.description: Applies the supplied facets in a single optimistic-concurrency-guarded update. The request carries the concurrencyStamp from the last read; a stale stamp yields 409. Returns 404 when the tag is missing, 422 when a rename collides with an existing (TenantId, Scope, Name) row.

delete.description: Removes the tag row. Cascading cleanup of orphan TagAssignment rows is handled by T5.1's EntityDeletedEto listener. Returns 404 when the tag is missing.

post.summary: Idempotently assigns a tag to a target aggregate.
post.description: Creates a new TagAssignment row for the given (TagId, TargetType, TargetId) triplet. When the row already exists, the existing row is returned with status 200 instead of 201 — the operation is idempotent. Returns 422 when targetType is not a registered taggable aggregate; 403 when the per-target permission check fails.

delete.description: Deletes the TagAssignment row matching the (TagId, TargetType, TargetId) triplet. Returns 204 on success, 404 when no matching row exists, 403 when the per-target permission check fails.

get.summary: Lists tags currently assigned to a target.
get.description: Returns every Tag assigned to (targetType, targetId), ordered by tag name. Both query parameters are mandatory.

get.summary: Cross-entity tag search grouped by target type.
get.description: Returns tags whose Name prefix-matches q (case-insensitive) along with the assignments grouped by TargetType so the frontend can dispatch to the matching rendering pipeline. Pass scope=* for cross-scope, otherwise the search is restricted to the matching Tag.Scope. SECURITY: results expose TargetIds the caller may not have per-entity read on — hosts MUST combine with their own per-entity ACL when rendering.

get.summary: Lists categories under a parent (or roots) within a scope.
get.description: Returns the direct children of parentId in the given scope, ordered by name. When parentId is omitted, returns the root categories of the scope. Use GET /categories/{id} to fetch a single category with its breadcrumb chain.

post.summary: Creates a new category — root or under an existing parent.
post.description: Creates a new category in the supplied scope. When parentId is supplied the new category is placed under it (must share scope). Returns 422 when the parent does not exist or is in a different scope, or when sibling-name uniqueness is violated.

get.summary: Returns a category with its breadcrumb chain.
get.description: Returns the category and its breadcrumb (root → leaf). Returns 404 when the category is missing or excluded by the tenant filter.

patch.summary: Partially updates a category (rename / icon / hide).
patch.description: Applies the supplied facets in turn. Renaming a category re-materialises descendant paths via a single SQL UPDATE. Returns 404 when the category is missing.

delete.summary: Hard-deletes a leaf category with no active assignments.
delete.description: Returns 422 when the category has descendants OR when one or more CategoryAssignment rows still reference it — callers must move / delete descendants and reassign / unassign targets first.

post.summary: Moves a category under a new parent (or to root).
post.description: Re-parents the category and re-materialises descendant paths and depths in a single SQL UPDATE. Returns 422 on cycle / cross-scope violations, 404 when the category or target parent is missing.

post.summary: Sets the category for a target. Replaces any existing assignment.
post.description: Single-assignment per target: if a previous assignment exists for (targetType, targetId), it is updated in place to point at the supplied category. Returns 200 on update, 201 on first assignment.

delete.summary: Clears the category assignment for a target.
delete.description: Removes the CategoryAssignment row for (targetType, targetId). Returns 204 on success, 404 when no assignment matches.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence.
